title: C: Merge Sort
description: Implement the merge sort algorithm using divide-and-conquer with a merge function.

steps.title: Merge Sort Implementation
steps.description: Implement `void merge_sort(int arr[], int l, int r)` and `void merge(int arr[], int l, int m, int r)`. Test with `{12, 11, 13, 5, 6, 7}`.
hints: Conquer: recursively sort left and right halves.
Combine: merge the two sorted halves.
